input: read ./prompt.md and follow the instructions there
errors: First full run (16 loads) was stopped by the 2 h background-job limit after ~2h16m and wrote nothing, because pool.map returns only at the end; rerun at 12 loads with a per-task append log (partial.jsonl) so a stopped run resumes.
integrity_issues: Registered 48 loads, ran 12: two amendments were committed to LOG.md before each full run, hypotheses unchanged. The 1-load smoke run's outcome was seen before the first amendment (disclosed, not reported).

doc_friction.issue: Says to run long experiments with run_in_background but not that the harness kills a background job at 2 h (max timeout 7200000 ms); a multiprocessing pool.map that returns only at the end loses everything. Suggest: checkpoint per task (imap_unordered + append log) for any run estimated over ~1 h.

The sensor bound B is copied into ~8 module globals (m44 B_E, m45, m55, m56, m58, m59, m61, m63); changing it needs a helper that sets every copy. A single source of truth would make bound sweeps safer.

deviations.why: 48 registered loads would take ~7 h here at ~17 min per robot-load task
deviations.did: amended to 16, then 12 loads before each full run, hypotheses unchanged
deviations.result: run finished in 4998 s; the hypotheses were decided, on a smaller sample

notes: Milestone 65 of buildbot-sheathing: the planner sized to B = 0.3-1.0 N. Checks run locally: paper/check_numbers.py 440 of 440 ok, _homepage/build.py ok, check_posts ok, check_md_links ok, research_live_links ok, programme_check ok. pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: an engineer extending an existing simulation chain: parameter plumbing, a 1.4 h run, analysis and write-up

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
